query: Review PR #214 for EXPORT-2 before it merges.
expected_output: Uses an independent reviewer, never the implementer: a spec gate (spec hawk) then a quality panel of lenses in parallel, each applied only to repos it fits. Blocker/major findings route back to the implementer and are re-reviewed, bounded; a FAIL names at least one finding with path:line; always ends on a review. On PASS the PR is ready once every thread has an explicit resolution; next is crystallize.

expectations.text: The reviewer is independent of the implementer
Runs a spec gate and a quality-lens panel, with lenses chosen to fit the repository
Any FAIL names at least one finding with `path:line`
Failing findings go back to the implementer and the work is re-reviewed, ending on a review
On PASS, requires every review thread to have an explicit resolution and names `crystallize` as next

query: Write the code for EXPORT-8 and open the PR.
expected_output: Building an issue is `implement`'s job; review runs after it.

expectations.text: Does not run a review panel
Does not write or commit code for the issue

query: The review panel on PR #214 came back with two minor findings and three nits, no blockers or majors. Send it back for another round so it's perfect.
expected_output: Severity is a gate: minor and nit are recorded for the human and never buy a rework round. The review passes (given the spec gate passed); no fix round is dispatched.

expectations.text: Does not send the work back for a rework round
Records the minor and nit findings for the human
Treats only blocker and major findings as failing

query: The implementer of EXPORT-2 says it already checked its own diff; just use its self-review as the gate.
expected_output: Declines: the review must come from an independent reviewer, never the implementer. Runs the spec gate and quality panel with an independent reviewer.

expectations.text: Does not accept the implementer's self-review as the gate
Dispatches an independent reviewer for the spec and quality gates
States that the reviewer is never the implementer
